constraints: all misses and non-certified callsites use fallback
no authoritative graph writes during shadow preparation
no provider calls during offline evaluation

service_models.name: observed_duration_replay

criteria: frozen parent hashes unchanged
new v6_1 namespace only
zero sockets, provider calls, and graph writes
all property, differential, and adversarial tests pass
zero false replay
zero publication inversion
zero duplicate consume
non-vacuous admission proof
response and DB work accounting correct
complete queue, policy, and interval trace
M0 reconstruction error below 1 percent on complete traces
M1 paired benefit 90 percent lower bound above zero
M2 worst-case T_build regression at most 5 percent
M3 native p95 inflation reduction at least 25 percent
completed but unused speculation at most 5 percent
no future admission while native waiter exists
cap, window, guard, cost, and adaptive mechanisms ablated
winner does not depend on one context or source outlier
work amplification separated from scheduler effect
no relaxed-order or invalid-QA equivalence claim

default_prior_not_winner.note: This is a conservative search prior, not a selected policy.
